meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 给 Claude 接上一个真实的 Dial 电话号码,用来收发短信和接打 AI 语音电话。它会拷入 Dial 适配器、配对助手和测试,追加注册 import,装依赖、构建并跑集成测试。
howto.when: 当你想给 Claude 配一个 Dial 电话号码、用它收发短信或接打语音电话时。技能会依次带你装 dial CLI、登录账号、选择谁可以给这条线发消息等步骤。

say.text: 帮我接入 Dial,给 Claude 配一个能收发短信的电话号码。
say.note: 会拷适配器、装依赖、构建并跑注册测试。

say.text: 我已经装过 Dial,把 add-dial 的配置步骤再跑一遍。
say.note: 所有步骤幂等,可安全重跑。

say.text: 这条 Dial 线设成只有我能发消息(owner)。
say.note: 注册时写入该线路的 strict 未知发送者策略。

howto.what_en: Gives Claude a real Dial phone number for SMS and AI voice calls. It copies the Dial adapter, pairing helper and tests into your project, installs deps, appends the register import, builds, and runs the integration test.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to add a Dial phone number for SMS or AI voice calls. It walks through installing the dial CLI, signing in, and choosing who may text the line.

say_en.text: Add Dial so Claude has a phone number for SMS and calls.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, builds, tests.

say_en.text: Re-run the add-dial setup steps; I already have Dial.
say_en.note: Every step is idempotent, so re-runs are safe.

say_en.text: Lock this Dial line to owner only.
say_en.note: Writes strict unknown-sender policy on the line.
